forum.title: FIT rates: STM32C092GCU6 & LIS2HH12TR
forum.best_answer_content:
Hello @ozguntural and welcome to STCommunity;

As mentioned in this article "[How to get MTBF/FIT values on STMicroelectronics products](https://community.st.com/t5/quality-reliability/how-to-get-mtbf-fit-values-on-stmicroelectronics-products/ta-p/685311)", to request the MTBF/FIT value on an STM32 or any given STMicroelectronics product, submit a new Online Support case at [https://my.st.com/ols.](https://my.st.com/ols "https://my.st.com/ols")

Thank you.

Kaouthar
forum.content_text:
**Dear ST Support Team,**

I am working on a reliability calculation for an industrial hardware design. I need the official failure rate data for the following components:

1. **STM32C092GCU6:** FMEDA report and FIT rates

2. **LIS2HH12TR:** Reliability report and FIT rates at 85°C.

These values are required to calculate the system's MTTFd and MTBF according to ISO 13849-1.

Could you please provide the available documentation for these parts?

Best regards,
forum.author: ozguntural
